_comment: The format of a gate profile, and the fixture the tests run against.
Nothing here is a real bank: the host does not resolve and the key is not
anyone's. Copy this to ~/.config/sparser/gates/<name>.json and fill in the
gate you actually need — the file stays on your machine, like secret.key.
Fields: {job} and {sequence} are substituted, url-quoted, into the paths.
name: example-bank-statement-gate
